For each Synchronized Time Base configured • for a Time Master • and to be stored non-volatile (i.e., StbMStoreTimebaseNonVolatile == STORAGE ) the StbM shall cyclically, with a cycle interval of StbMCyclicBackupInterval , store a backup time to NvM . The StbM shall calculate the value of the backup time as: • current time of the Time Base + StbMCyclicBackupInterval . The initial value of the backup time in the NvM shall be set to 0.

The StbM shall calculate the value of the backup time as: • current time of the Time Base + StbMCyclicBackupInterval . The initial value of the backup time in the NvM shall be set to 0.

The StbM shall calculate the value of the backup time as: • current time of the Time Base + StbMCyclicBackupInterval. The initial value of the backup time in the NvM shall be set to 0.

Cyclic update of Backup Time For each Synchronized Time Base configured as a Time Master if • StbMStoreTimebaseNonVolatile == STORAGE • and StbMCyclicBackupInterval > 0, then the StbM shall cyclically, with a cycle interval of StbMCyclicBackupInterval , store a backup time to the NvM . The StbM shall calculate the value of the backup time as: • new backup time = current Local Instance of the Global Time + StbM- CyclicBackupInterval . The initial value of the backup time in the NvM shall be set to 0.
